examples: 1 Cr as soon as possible

themes.description: Investors expect their regular contributions to build a sufficient financial nest egg over multi-decade time horizons.
examples: Wealth creation over 20 years

examples: High growth and US dollar hedging

themes.theme: Unsure about SIP and autopay rules
themes.description: Questions and confusion regarding how SIP cancelling, pausing, step-up, autopay limits, and missed installment policies work.
examples: Unsure if cancelling SIP stops it automatically
Unsure if SIP resumes automatically after withdrawal
Unsure what happens after cancelling a SIP

themes.theme: Order status and payment processing delays
themes.description: Worries about money being debited from bank accounts while orders, units, or status remain stuck in progress, failed, or missing.
examples: Payment missing from dashboard after 3 months
Conflict between bank limit statement and app transaction failure error
Cancelled SIP status not updating

themes.theme: Confused by portfolio displays and calculations
themes.description: Discrepancies and misunderstandings regarding portfolio holdings, returns metrics like XIRR, valuation updates, unit counts, and transaction histories.
examples: Holding value versus redemption value mismatch
Groww dashboard missing investments shown in CAS statement
Invested and return amounts mismatch between Groww and MF Central

themes.description: Uncertainty on whether to pause, adjust, or continue SIP investments when market conditions or returns fluctuate.
examples: Unsure whether to stay invested or withdraw during stock market drops
Whether to perform daily SWP or one-shot withdrawal to fund a daily SIP
Unsure if one-time payment merges with missed regular SIP

themes.description: Confusion surrounding Demat vs SOA holding formats, unwanted folio creation, and external fund tracking issues.
examples: Dashboard showing incorrect mutual fund folio information
Source folios still displayed after consolidation and purchases getting rejected
Unauthorised creation of demat folios

themes.description: Questions and worries concerning redemption processes, timelines, exit loads, capital gains tax, and lock-in periods.
examples: Confused about exit load or tax charges on withdrawal after 1 year
Unable to initiate or complete SIP redemption
Difference between estimated redemption amount and final credited amount

themes.theme: Demands for account and mandate updates
themes.description: Trouble setting up, updating, or changing bank details, mandates, phone numbers, contact info, and nominee details.
examples: How to setup SIP mandate without debit card or netbanking
How to authenticate mandate for bank account with limited card facilities
No visibility into active autopay status or date after bank account change

themes.description: App crashes, technical bugs, accidental inputs, and fears over platform reliability or loss of funds.
examples: Groww wallet money cannot be used for mutual funds
SIP calculator tool not functioning
Surprised by SIP bounce and bank charges

themes.description: New investors looking for basic instructions on how to select funds, make payments, and initiate SIPs.
examples: Cannot find app in laptop app store to start SIP
Does not know how to invest in SIP or which fund to pick
Confusing and hard to navigate for new beginners

themes.description: Confusion and complaints regarding NAV dates, cut-off times, price mismatches on purchase or switch, and non-working day orders.
examples: Unsure why SIP deduction timing delayed during market crash
Why money is debited on weekends when investment does not happen immediately
Mutual fund NAV displays a different date

themes.description: Friction during registration, identity verification errors, Aadhaar/PAN prompts, and account setup failures.

themes.theme: Clear guidance on SIP management and rules
themes.description: Investors seek clearer instructions, explanations, and guidance on rules regarding SIP setup, pauses, cancellations, redemptions, penalties, and tax implications.
examples: Clear authentication guidance for minor accounts
Guidance on how to start SIP and fund selection
Clear policy communication on bounce charges and alerts

themes.description: Miscellaneous investor needs regarding app usability, specific investment products, security, and market timing features.
examples: Ability to invest in mutual funds using wallet balance
Debit SIP amount only on business days when units are allocated
Ability to redeem or transfer mutual funds freely

themes.theme: Reliable autopay, mandates, and payment execution
themes.description: Investors need smooth, automated SIP debit processing, reliable UPI/eNACH mandate setups, and no unexpected bank bounce charges.
examples: Clear error resolution for mandate transaction limit issues
Smooth SIP autopay activation using third party UPI apps
Single aggregated debit for multiple SIP mandates on the same day

themes.theme: Flexible SIP frequencies and payment options
themes.description: Investors want more choices for SIP execution timing, including daily or weekly frequencies, manual payment options, and lump-sum top-ups.
examples: Option to setup weekly SIP frequency
Option for daily SIP
Weekly and biweekly SIP frequency options

themes.theme: Timely processing and responsive customer support
themes.description: Investors require prompt order execution, quick refund handling for failed transactions, accurate status updates, and responsive support.
examples: Reliable SIP processing and responsive support for failed orders
Transparent order processing and responsive customer support
Faster processing of mutual fund SIP orders

themes.theme: Clear dashboard tracking and return analytics
themes.description: Investors want consolidated holdings views, accurate XIRR calculations, detailed return charts, and clear total investment displays.
examples: Clear display of active autopay details and status
Proper display of invested mutual funds
XIRR calculation for overall portfolio performance

themes.theme: Consolidation of external folios and non-demat options
themes.description: Investors want to import, sync, or switch external mutual fund holdings, manage SOA format investments, and consolidate direct folios.
examples: Accurate mutual fund holding statements and proper reconciliation
Proper updating and syncing of external mutual fund holdings
Automatic updating and sync of consolidated folios on dashboard

themes.description: Investors want easy options to edit, step up, pause, skip, or cancel SIPs without deleting mandates or incurring penalties.
examples: Auto-hide cancelled or rejected SIPs after 30 days
Instant cancellation processing
Easy toggle to turn off or disable SIP autopay

themes.theme: Seamless KYC onboarding and profile management
themes.description: Investors need smooth digital KYC verification, easy bank account updates, and hassle-free document processing for starting SIPs.
examples: Timely KYC verification
Faster KYC completion
Timely updating of contact details with AMC

themes.description: Investors need quick mutual fund redemption processing, transparent NAV application dates, and timely credit of withdrawn funds.
examples: Liquidity during fund crises
Timely redemption payout and effective customer support
Timely redemption processing and responsive customer support

themes.theme: Advanced fund features and switching options
themes.description: Investors desire advanced mutual fund features like SWP, STP, direct plan conversions, fund switching, and pledging units for trading.
examples: Advanced sorting and filtering options for mutual funds
STP option for mutual funds
Provide SWP and STP options for mutual funds

themes.description: Investors seek custom goal tagging, portfolio categorization, family account tracking, calculators, and custom fund notes.
examples: Working SIP calculator tool in app
Feature to add custom notes on mutual funds
Goal mapping and target textboxes for mutual fund SIP dashboard
